crew.overview: In the late 1990s, the arrival of elderly invalid Patrick into Marion and Tom’s home triggers the exploration of seismic events from 40 years previous: the passionate relationship between Tom and Patrick at a time when homosexuality was illegal.
crew.title: My Policeman

crew.overview: The story of Joy Division’s lead singer Ian Curtis, from his schoolboy days in 1973 to his suicide on the eve of the band's first American tour in 1980.
crew.title: Control

crew.overview: A young man who was sentenced to 7 years in prison for robbing a post office ends up spending 30 years in solitary confinement. During this time, his own personality is supplanted by his alter ego, Charles Bronson.
crew.title: Bronson

details.biography: Tina Pawlik is an award winning Line Producer and Production Manager with a background in short film Producing and feature film production. She was selected as one of the Screen International ‘Stars of Tomorrow’ and also successfully completed a number of production placements as part of the Magic Light Pictures ‘Production Placement Programme’. She won a Primetime Emmy in 2021 for Outstanding Comedy Series for Ted Lasso and a 2021 Pena de Prata Award for Ted Lasso as well. She is currently the production manager for Vertigo Films and has worked for Anthem Films, Partizan, Formosa Films, Broadway Productions, Trisha and Olswang. She is a graduate of Nottingham Trent University with an MA in Cinema Studies.
details.name: Tina Pawlik
